description: Subscribe an email address to free daily expiry monitoring of up to 5 domains (certificate, domain registration and security grade) with email alerts, plus an optional Slack/Discord/Telegram/webhook channel. Also alerts when Certificate Transparency logs show a new certificate for a domain from a CA not seen before (possible unauthorized issuance). Double opt-in: a confirmation email is sent and monitoring starts only after the recipient clicks the link; one confirmation email per address per 24 hours. Use only an address the user owns and explicitly asked to use.

critDays.description: Days before expiry that count as CRITICAL "expiring soon" (default 15; must be < warnDays)

domains.description: Domain names to monitor (host or host:port). For paid certificates you may append the contract (subscription) end date and the DCV method, e.g. "shop.example.com 2027-05-01 email". Contract expiry is alerted with the same thresholds and email DCV gets a reminder (email DCV ends 2028-03-15, CA/B Forum SC-090). A trailing "45/20" sets per-domain WARN/CRITICAL days.

email.description: Email address that will receive the alerts

slackWebhook.description: Deprecated alias of webhook that accepts only Slack Incoming Webhook URLs (https://hooks.slack.com/services/...).

warnDays.description: Days before expiry that count as WARN (default 30; the default shrinks for short-lived certificates)

webhook.description: Optional alert channel URL. Alerts are also posted there after confirmation. Accepts a Slack or Discord incoming-webhook URL, a Telegram URL https://api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/sendMessage?chat_id=<CHAT_ID>, or any public https endpoint (receives JSON POST, version 1). It is a secret; only pass a URL the user gave you.

name: watch_expiry
